book.title: Phawuloosi Qorontoose Asaas Xaafida Nam7anththo Kiita

content: Mernaas Daanaso
Nuni izan biittaa bolla diza dunkaaney laalettikokka asa kushen gidontta Xoossa kushen oosettida mernaa keeththi nuus salon dizayssa nu eroos.
He wodey gakkanaas nu keeththaa saloyssa may7anaas nu laamoti naagoos.
Tumappe hessa nu may7idaappe guye kallottoko.

Nuni hayssa ha dunkaanezan diza wode ubbaan izi deexxiza gishshas daabura piidhi goos; hessas gaasoykka hayqqizayssi de7on laamettana mala nuni salon daana sohoza may7ana attiin nuuppe qaarettana mala nu koyokko.
Hessas nuna giigsiday Xoossa; buro yaanayssas waase gidana mala nuus ba Ayana immiday iza.
Nuni ashon diza wode Godaappe haakki dizayssa erikkoka izan ammanettidi doos.
Nuni diza duussay Godaan ammanidi attiin ayfen be7on gidenna.
Nuni ashoppe shaakettidi Godaara duus dooranayssa ta sidhontta yootays.
Hessa gishshas nuni ashon diikko woykko ashoppe shaakettikokka nuus waanna qofay Godaa ufaysso.
Nuni wurikka Kirstoosa pirda wombora sinth shiiqanayssi attenna; nuuppe issoy issoy biitta bolla ba ooththiday iita gidiin woykko lo7o gidiin ba ooso mala bessiza waaga baas ekkana.
Xoossara As Maqayinththo

Hessa gishshas Godaas yashsha guussi ay guussakonne nu eriza gishshas asay nu yootizayssa ero gi ekkana mala ooththanaas daaburoos; nuni oonanttako Xoossa achchan qoncce; qasseka intte wozinankka qoncce gididayssa ta ammanays.

Ta hessa gizay nuna intte sinththan galatanaas gidontta dishin intte nunan ceeqettana mala attiin wozinappe gidontta ayfen beettiza miishshan ceeqettizaytas intte zaaro immanaas dandayana mala gaada gays.
Nu goosh gidikko Xoossa gishshas giidi gooyidos; erata gidikkoka inttes giidikko!
Kirstoosi ubbaas issito hayqqoyssanne haray wurikka izara issife hayqqidayssa nu erida gishshas Kirstoosa siiqoy nuna wolqqara oosisees.
Shemppora paxa dizayti wurikka he hayqqidayssassinne hayqoppe dendidayssas daana malappe attiin hayssafe guye istti baas dontta mala Kirstoosi ubbaas hayqqides.
Hessa gishshas hayssafe guye nuni ay asikka asho ayfen xeelloko; nuni hayssafe kase Kirstoosa asho ayfen xeellidaa gidikkoka hayssafe guye hessaththo xeelloko.
Hessa gishshas oonikka Kirstoosa bagga gidikko izi ooraththa medheteththa; kase ceega medheteththi aadhdhides; izi kichchoosan hara ooraththa medheteththi gelides.
Hessi wuri haniday izi nuna banara Kirstoosa baggara maqayinththidinne maqayinththo ooso nuus immida Xoossanna.
Hessika Xoossi Kirstoosa baggara hankko alame asaa wursika banara maqayinththides guussa; istta qohozakka qoodibeenna; nuni as Godaara maqayinththana qaala nuuska immides.
Xoossi nu baggara as xeygiza gishshas nuni qasse Kirstoosa ogaththata; hessa gishshas, «Intte Xoossara maqaynnite!» giidi nu inttena Kirstoosa sunththan woossoos.
Nuni Kirstoosa baggara Xoossa xilloteth gishetti ekkizayta gidana mala Xoossi iza bolla nagaray baynda Kirstoosa izi nu nagara tookkana mala ooththides.
